newsitem.title: USA: Teltrend Q2 Jan 25 net off on sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Teltrend Q2 Jan 25 net off on sales fall.

text.p: Teltrend Inc said Tuesday said a decline in sales directly contributed to previously anticipated lower earnings in the second quarter ended January 25.

The company said net income reached $2.0 million, or $0.30 a share, compared to $2.7 million, or $0.41 a share, one year ago. Sales fell to $18.8 million from $20.5 million in the corresponding period in 1996.
Teltrend said the usual negative impacts in the quarter were not offset in late 1996 as in years past by year-end buys by its major customers.
Teltrend provides local loop products to telephone companies.
Its shares closed up 1/8 Tuesday at 18-1/8.
